Hi — following up with the requested specifics and the artifacts attached. Short summary here:

- Audit window: 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (SOC 2 Type II). The redacted PDF attached highlights the scope and the control descriptions. The full report is available under NDA.
- Controls covered: encryption at rest/in transit, key management practices, access control, privileged access reviews, logging & monitoring, change management and incident response testing were in scope.
- Hosting/dataflow: For our hosted product we place customer data in EU regions for EU/UK tenants; control-plane orchestration metadata is routed via our control plane which operates in the US for operational reasons, but no customer PII is retained in the control plane beyond routing metadata. See attached dataflow-eu-hosting-diagram.png for a high-level view.
- Cross-border: We rely on SCCs for EU transfers and support the UK IDTA where customers require it. We also provide a bridge/assurance letter on request that states project-specific transfer mechanisms during the audit window.
- Key management: Customer-managed keys available on Dedicated and Private. Hosted customers can request BYOK on enterprise agreements; see redwood-kms-overview-stub.pdf for details. Support engineers can access ephemeral logs for troubleshooting; we limit access by role and the logs are retained in-region unless a customer authorizes cross-region export for diagnostics.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30_redacted.pdf; dataflow-eu-hosting-diagram.png; redwood-kms-overview-stub.pdf

If you’d like the unredacted SOC report, we can send it after an NDA is in place — I can circulate our standard mutual NDA or accept yours.

Best,
Stephanie
